title: Wikimedia Projects
sub: Uganda across every Wikimedia project: size, visibility and the gaps between them

items.n: Wikisource, Wikiquote, Wikivoyage and the rest

blocks.text: Counts come from each project's own search for the word "Uganda", so they include every page that mentions it, not only pages about it. Content pages are the project's own count. A project with no Luganda or Swahili edition is simply not listed for that language.

Each is an analysis dashboard like the Wikipedia one: how many pages, how big, how read, how they have grown, who edited them and what needs work. Keep the project_dashboards folder beside this file for the links to work.

items.b: 177,259 pages across 19 Wikimedia projects and editions mention Uganda; Wikidata (92,123), English Wikipedia (58,574) and Swahili Wikipedia (6,035) hold the most.

Relative to size, Uganda is most visible on Wikipedia (Luganda): 73% of its pages mention Uganda, then Wikipedia (Swahili) (4.6%) and Meta-Wiki (2.9%). Luganda Wikipedia is the only project where a majority of pages are Ugandan.
Luganda Wikipedia has 5,874 content pages and 92 active editors — the smallest base of any edition that carries so much Ugandan content.
Of 8,839 Ugandan Wikipedia articles, 14% have a Commons page, 6% a Wikiquote page and 7% a Wikispecies page; 46% appear in Luganda Wikipedia and 16% in Swahili.
1,785 Ugandan articles exist in no other Wikipedia — they are the first candidates for translation.
Items with no image (67,871); Items with an English label and no Luganda label (60,595); Files used on no Wikimedia project (50,051).
